caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed with four turned legs and a high headboard and footboard, both of which feature a curved top and elongated oval cut-out designs. The wood is rendered in light to medium brown tones with visible grain patterns. The sides of the bed are solid panels, and a mattress with a white cover is partially visible inside the frame. The perspective shows the bed slightly from above, with the left side of the bed facing the viewer. The name "FRITZ BOEHMER." appears in small, uppercase letters beneath the bed, centered near the bottom left of the image, on a plain beige background.
title: Zoar Child's Bed
